\noindent
Forty-five strains to construct: 25 double knockouts and 20 triple knockouts.
Every one of them is made from a strain that already exists, so no new single
knockout is needed and no cross waits on another. Tables~\ref{tab:new-doubles}
and~\ref{tab:new-triples} are the build list.
Tables~\ref{tab:existing-singles} and~\ref{tab:existing-doubles} are the strains
in hand, and Table~\ref{tab:plate} is the plate they are all measured on.
